gaps.place: Pescadero, CA 94060 — San Mateo County coast, 35mi south of San Francisco
gaps.classification: Coastal frontier — artichoke + strawberry belt, nearest no-retailer spot to Bay Area
gaps.retail_gap: No chain grocer in town; Arcangeli Grocery (Pescadero) + tiny farm stands only. Nearest full grocer 18mi (Half Moon Bay Safeway) and Costco 30mi (South SF / Redwood City). One winding two-lane road in.
gaps.kodiak_opportunity: KODIAK® × Pescadero — artichoke + Marin goat cheese savory flapjacks. Nourishment for the Bay's frontier

gaps.fulfillment: DTC subscription where the road turns to two lanes — ships to Pescadero, Half Moon Bay, and SF. Amazon.com ads seen alongside Seattle if Washington noted — same for Bay Area: use your location or choose from list to see what your Costco sees.

gaps.place: Neah Bay, WA 98357 — northwestern tip of Olympic Peninsula, Makah Tribe
gaps.classification: Frontier — farthest northwestern tip Olympic Peninsula, Makah Tribe, outermost Washington
gaps.retail_gap: Only mini-marts and Washburn's General Store in Neah Bay (limited SKU). Nearest full grocer Port Angeles Safeway / Walmart — 70mi winding 2-lane SR-112 / US-101. 4–5hr to Seattle including Puget Sound ferry (Edmonds–Kingston or Bainbridge).
